name: Delta Corp Limited

annual_report.business: Delta Corp Limited operates in India's organised gaming and hospitality sector, running land-based and offshore casinos along with associated hospitality assets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Upon commencement of operations, the vessel is expected to nearly double our gaming capacity while materially enhancing the overall customer experience.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter – Fair Valuation of Investee Companies engaged in real money gaming business: The enactment of the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 prohibits operation of online gaming businesses involving real-money stakes, resulting in Rs 378.34 Crores recorded as cumulative reduction in fair values through OCI during the current year.

key_risks: Regulatory developments including revised GST regime across gaming businesses

Bombay High Court dismissal of licensing petition for casino-style amusement machines at Deltin Hotel, Daman
